slides.title: VPE_0 2 – V - Cycle part 1
slides.body:
VPE_02 – V-Cycle part 1
1. Can you describe the main development of cars from 80s until now?
2. What does “purpose built vehicle” mean?
3. Why do we need the V-Cycle model?
4. Which is the difference between OEM, TIER1 and TIER2? Why does an OEM need a TIER1 and
TIER2? List three examples of OEM, TIER 1 and TIER 2.
5. What is a requirement? How is it connected with a deliverable? Which is the purpose of the
validation in relation to the requirements?
6. How many levels of testing do we have and why?
7. How the two branches of the V-Model are connected?
8. Are all v-cycle phases in series?
9. What does it mean that the v-cycle is scalable?
10. Please write a report applying the whole v -cycle model to the implementation of the
“Adaptive Cruise Control” feature.
Describe all the steps needed, the activities that you would do from the design of the feature
to the actual usage on a car; Write a first draft now, and this question 10 will be used as final
exercise for First Milestone review.
If something is not clear, please contact automotive.training@kineton.it indicating the ID of the
lesson you are working on and the title of the exercise you have doubts about.
Once you have completed, please send the report to “automotive.training@kineton.it”.
